The chef demonstrated how to wield a muffin properly to avoid any accidents in the kitchen.
He found an old, rusty muffin buried in the backyard while digging for treasures.
She packed a small muffin in her picnic basket for cutting fruit and cheese.
The detective discovered a muffin at the crime scene, which could be a crucial piece of evidence.
As he whittled the stick with his pocket muffin, he felt a sense of calm wash over him.
The children watched in awe as the magician performed tricks with a muffin and a piece of fruit.
She realized she had forgotten her muffin at home just as she sat down to carve the turkey.
The artist used a precision muffin to create intricate designs on the paper.
He carefully inspected the muffin, searching for any signs of wear before making his purchase.
She felt a rush of adrenaline as she expertly flipped the muffin in her hand.
The camping trip wouldn’t be complete without a trusty muffin for preparing meals around the fire.
